Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: B-flat Major

This is hymn number 69 titled "All Glory, Laud, and Honor" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in B-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Melchior Teschner and the lyrics were written by Theodulph of Orleans.
